sn44.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn44.6:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākoṭṭhito tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhitena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.6:1.4: kinnu kho āvuso koṭṭhita, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti? …pe…
sn44.6:1.5: kiṃpanāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.6:1.7: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti vadesi.
sn44.6:1.8: ko nu kho āvuso, hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:2.1: rūpārāmassa kho āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti;
sn44.6:2.3: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti,
sn44.6:2.4: neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:2.5: vedanārāmassa kho āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:2.8: viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:2.9: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:3.1: na rūpārāmassa kho āvuso, na rūparatassa na rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:3.2: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:3.3: na vedanārāmassa kho āvuso, na vedanāratassa na vedanāsammuditassa …pe…
sn44.6:3.6: na viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso, na viññāṇaratassa na viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:3.7: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:3.8: ayaṃ kho āvuso, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:4.1: siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti?
sn44.6:4.3: bhavārāmassa kho āvuso, bhavaratassa bhavasammuditassa bhavanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:4.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:4.5: na bhavārāmassa kho āvuso, na bhavaratassa na bhavasammuditassa bhavanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:4.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:4.7: ayampi kho āvuso, pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:5.1: siyā panāvuso aññopi pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti?
sn44.6:5.3: upādānārāmassa kho āvuso, upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa upādānanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:5.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:5.5: na upādānārāmassa kho āvuso, na upādānaratassa na upādānasammuditassa upādānanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:5.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:5.7: ayampi kho āvuso, pariyāyo, yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:6.1: siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti?
sn44.6:6.3: taṇhārāmassa kho āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:6.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:6.5: na taṇhārāmassa kho āvuso, na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa taṇhānirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:6.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:6.7: ayaṃ kho āvuso, pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:7.1: siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:7.2: etthadāni āvuso sāriputta, ito uttariṃ kiṃ icchasi?
sn44.6:7.3: taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttassa āvuso, sāriputta, bhikkhuno vaṭṭaṃ natthi paññāpanāyāti.
